en_title: Rockstar's Multi-Million Dollar Miami Takeover Continues to Expand Ahead of GTA 6 Launch, Despite Protests from Some Officials
subtitle: 把罪恶都市搬进现实
opus_summary: Rockstar继续扩大《GTA6》在迈阿密的宣传，广告覆盖体育场，并将举办主题NBA比赛。部分官员反对合作，据报道正试图阻止扩大宣传的谈判，主题飞艇也可能飞往佛罗里达。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games is continuing to ramp up GTA 6's massive marketing with a Vice City blimp, NFL promos, and much more, despite protests from some Miami officials.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管迈阿密部分官员提出反对，Rockstar仍在继续扩大《GTA6》的大规模宣传，宣传形式包括罪恶都市主题飞艇、NFL推广活动等。

paragraphs.en: For the last two months, Rockstar has been setting up marketing for what will likely be one of the biggest, if not the biggest, releases in entertainment history. It kicked things off with a massive gameplay reveal on Netflix , followed by a blitz of merch and add-ons such as an album featuring original music created for GTA 6 . Now, Rockstar is taking over the real world to help spread the word of what's to come on November 19.
paragraphs.cn: 过去两个月，Rockstar一直在为《GTA6》筹备宣传。这款游戏即使不会成为娱乐史上规模最大的发行，也很可能位列其中。Rockstar先是在Netflix大规模展示实机内容，随后密集推出周边及配套产品，包括收录《GTA6》原创音乐的专辑。如今，Rockstar正把宣传铺向现实世界，为11月19日的发售造势。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar is currently focusing marketing on the city of Miami. GTA 6 takes place in a fictional version of Miami known as Vice City, so Rockstar is utilizing the city for a lot of its advertising, which has led to friction between city officials. Some are all for it, as they hope it attracts more tourism and generates increased revenue. Others, however, are strongly opposed and have been for weeks.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar目前将宣传重点放在迈阿密。《GTA6》的故事发生在以迈阿密为原型的虚构城市罪恶都市，因此Rockstar在迈阿密投放了大量广告，这也引发了当地官员之间的分歧。一些官员全力支持，希望宣传能吸引更多游客、增加收入；另一些官员则强烈反对，而且这一态度已持续数周。

paragraphs.en: According to The Miamian, County Commissioner René Garcia has expressed displeasure over the marketing campaign for GTA 6 in Miami, reporting he's "really uncomfortable with this whole thing." Specifically, Garcia doesn't like that the city is collaborating with a "game that's depicting Miami like a crime haven; Miami like a murder capital.”
paragraphs.cn: 据The Miamian报道，县委员René Garcia对《GTA6》在迈阿密的宣传活动表达了不满，称自己「对整件事真的感到很不舒服」。具体而言，Garcia不满的是，迈阿密正在与一款「把迈阿密描绘成犯罪天堂、谋杀之都的游戏」合作。

paragraphs.en: Garcia and other officials are reportedly attempting to squash negotiations with Rockstar to expand its marketing efforts for GTA 6 in the city, which allegedly include ads at Miami International Airport and a $4 million transformation of Miami Beach. The rollout was expected to begin as soon as October 15, but Miami journalist Joel Franco stated that an unnamed official doubts that deals will be finalized in time.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，Garcia及其他官员正试图阻止当地与Rockstar就扩大《GTA6》宣传展开的谈判。据称，相关计划包括在迈阿密国际机场投放广告，以及耗资400万美元(约合人民币2680万元)改造迈阿密海滩。宣传原本预计最早于10月15日启动，但迈阿密记者Joel Franco表示，一位未具名官员怀疑相关协议能否及时敲定。

paragraphs.en: In September, Rockstar paid just shy of $1 million to install a massive, glowing "Welcome to Vice City" sign on top of the Miami Heat's arena, the Kaseya Center . The arena will also be home to an unprecedented NBA game sponsored by Rockstar Games. On November 18, the Miami Heat will play a regular season game against the Milwaukee Bucks on a Vice City-themed court with never-before-seen jerseys inspired by GTA 6 . The arena will also be selling Vice City merch, with Rockstar and the NBA labeling the event as a "night in Vice City."
paragraphs.cn: 9月，Rockstar支付了近100万美元(约合人民币670万元)，在迈阿密热火队主场Kaseya Center顶部安装了一块巨大的发光标牌，上面写着「欢迎来到罪恶都市」。这座球馆还将举办一场由Rockstar赞助、前所未有的NBA比赛。11月18日，迈阿密热火队将在罪恶都市主题球场上与密尔沃基雄鹿队展开常规赛较量，并穿上以《GTA6》为灵感、从未亮相过的新球衣。球馆还将销售罪恶都市周边，Rockstar和NBA将这场活动称为「罪恶都市之夜」。

paragraphs.en: Over the weekend, Miami's Hard Rock Stadium, the home of the Miami Dolphins, was covered in GTA 6 ads. The stadium's jumbotron featured ads for the game, promoting its release date. During touchdowns, the screen also had a GTA 6-themed animation with text that read "In for VI," in reference to the team scoring six points.
paragraphs.cn: 周末，迈阿密海豚队的主场硬石体育场遍布《GTA6》广告。体育场的大屏幕播放了游戏广告，宣传其发售日期。球队达阵时，屏幕还会播放《GTA6》主题动画，配上「In for VI」字样，呼应球队拿下六分。

paragraphs.en: New image of Hard Rock Stadium #GTAVI marketing on the actual live cam screen via @golfoscar69
paragraphs.cn: 硬石体育场现场摄像画面中的《GTA6》宣传新图，来自@golfoscar69。

paragraphs.en: Now, a blimp appears to be on its way to Florida as well. A Goodyear blimp with Vice City branding is currently flying out of Ohio and is reportedly on its way to North Carolina. It's speculated that it will eventually make its way to Florida, possibly during other sporting events or other planned marketing activations in the coming weeks. Rockstar has also put up at least one Vice City mural in Miami. It's clear Rockstar is ready to spend whatever it takes to get the word out and to effectively turn Miami into a real version of Vice City.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，似乎还有一艘飞艇正在前往佛罗里达。一艘带有罪恶都市标识的固特异飞艇正从俄亥俄州飞出，据报道正飞往北卡罗来纳州。有人推测，它最终会前往佛罗里达，可能会配合未来几周的其他体育赛事或已计划的宣传活动亮相。Rockstar还在迈阿密绘制了至少一幅罪恶都市主题壁画。显然，Rockstar已经准备好不惜成本扩大宣传，把迈阿密真正变成现实版罪恶都市。

paragraphs.en: Goodyear Blimp with Vice City livery is currently flying south out of Akron, Ohio. Scheduled to stop in North Carolina this afternoon. Wondering if it’ll head to South Florida for the big marketing kickoff on Thursday? 👀
paragraphs.cn: 一艘采用罪恶都市涂装的固特异飞艇正从俄亥俄州阿克伦向南飞行，计划于今天下午在北卡罗来纳州停留。不知道它会不会前往南佛罗里达，参加周四的大型宣传启动活动？👀

paragraphs.en: 📸: Cecil Richmond/Goodyear Blimp Fan Club https://t.co/AloPE0LdVR
Meanwhile, there's plenty going on in the world of GTA 6, including an alleged PC release window , ongoing leaks , and much more.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，《GTA6》还有不少其他消息，包括据称的PC版发售时间范围、持续出现的泄露内容等。
